narrative.roadmap_md: The roadmap below sequences the eight recommendations into four phases. The sequencing is not arbitrary—it follows directly from three the other capabilities that build on it that the assessment identified in the scoring data. These dependencies function as hard constraints: initiatives in later phases cannot produce their intended outcomes until the enabling capabilities from earlier phases are in place. The roadmap does not prescribe timelines or investment amounts, because those decisions belong to Rockland Trust’s leadership team and depend on resourcing, vendor negotiations, and competing institutional priorities. What the roadmap does prescribe is the order in which capabilities must be built, the measurable outcomes each phase should produce, and the maturity trajectory the institution can expect if the evidence-based gaps are addressed.
